description: Defines the ue_resume_routine class responsible for handling UE connection resume procedures in a 5G/3GPP context, including context setup, release, and security management.

classes.name: ue_resume_routine
classes.description: Handles the UE Connection Resume process, managing context setup, release, and security procedures.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the routine asynchronously within a coroutine context.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the routine: 'RRC Resume Routine'.

methods.name: fill_du_ue_context_release_command
methods.description: Prepares a command to release UE context at the DU.

methods.name: generate_ue_context_setup_request
methods.description: Creates a UE context setup request message.

methods.name: handle_ue_context_setup_response
methods.description: Processes the response to the UE context setup request.

methods.name: add_security_context_to_bearer_context_modification
methods.description: Adds security context to bearer modification request.

methods.name: fill_rrc_resume_request_response
methods.description: Fills the response message for RRC resume request.
